en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. All of my scholars narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Ḥasan ibn Faďďāl, from Yūnus ibn Ya’qūb, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) about how to bid farewell to the grave of the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.). Imam (a.s.) replied: Recite the following:            Allāh’s blessing be upon you. Salām to you. May Allāh not make this the last time I say Salām to you.
